verdict.rationale: Recruitee's own features page lists "Employee referrals" as a product capability, so a first-party referral feature exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how an employee submits a referral, tracks it, or sees its pipeline stage. missing for 10: documented employee referral submission flow, referral status tracking, employee-facing visibility into where the referral stands in the pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
